name: Robert A. Michael

background_rationale: Began in Abbott's financial development program and rose through finance to become AbbVie's CFO before moving into commercial and operating leadership.

notable.summary: AbbVie's board named Michael chairman effective July 1, 2025, succeeding founding CEO Richard Gonzalez, who retired from the board.
AbbVie agreed to acquire Capstan Therapeutics, a developer of in vivo CAR-T therapies for autoimmune diseases, for up to $2.1 billion.

AbbVie reached an agreement with the Trump administration to invest $100 billion in U.S. R&D and capital over a decade, lower Medicaid prices and offer drugs via TrumpRx, in exchange for tariff and pricing-mandate exemptions.
AbbVie selected North Carolina for a new $1.4 billion U.S. manufacturing campus.

personal_story.hook: Rob Michael started in Abbott's financial development program and spent three decades in finance and operations before becoming CEO.
personal_story.summary: Michael studied accounting at Indiana University's Kelley School of Business and later earned an MBA at UCLA Anderson. He began his career in Abbott's financial development program and worked across its diagnostics, diabetes care and nutrition businesses before the 2013 spin-off of AbbVie, where he built the company's first financial planning organization. He became CFO in 2018 and then took on commercial and operating roles before succeeding Richard Gonzalez as CEO in July 2024.
